as_told.title: Jake approached Herrera; Jake's admitted red-team role probing whistleblowers

plain: In 2023, at a whistleblower conference held at the National Press Club in Washington DC by the UFO activist Steven Greer, a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says he was in the audience on his employer's orders, sent "to look for whistleblowers". He calls this red-teaming: probing the people coming forward to find out who knew what. Barber says it was there that he heard a man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot craft in the Indonesian jungle, tell his story. Herrera himself says he was suspicious when Barber first approached him, but that Barber has since been open about his role as a red-team asset, while Michels, putting it to Greer, describes it as Barber coming to infiltrate Greer's camp.
